{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Silicon''' was one of many elements in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It bonded with [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] to make [[Silica/Legends|silica]] and [[Quartz/Legends|quartz]].

Silicon shared some of the same properties of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], and was the only possible rival for the role of carbon in biology. However, silicon could only bond with two other atoms, whereas carbon could bond with up to four other atoms at once, and was therefore able to form long molecular chains and rings, the backbones of organic molecules. Because of the limitations of silicon, silicon-based lifeforms were extremely rare.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

Silicon was the base element for [[Vacuumbreather|vacuum-breathing]] [[Species/Legends|species]] like the [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]] and [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] and the mineral lifeform [[rainbow gem]]s and [[Shard (species)|Shards]]. The [[Silika]] people of [[Dohu VII]] were also composed of silicon.

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]] wrote in a report that despite extensive research, he had yet to encounter an example of [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] silicon life;<ref name="GG4" /> apparently, he had never heard about the Shards or the Silika. The [[Q'Maere Research Facility|research facility]] on [[Q'Maere]], headed by the [[Qektoth Confederation]] scientist [[Drigor Tarrens]], was known to conduct experiments with silicon biology. However, these experiments failed, and the facility was left to be managed by students of the [[University of Sanbra]].<ref name="TKR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]'', "[[Harm's Way]]"</ref>
